# openwrt_firewall_defaults (Resource)

Global firewall defaults (`config defaults`).

Manages a `defaults` section in `/etc/config/firewall`. This section normally exists on a stock router: creating the resource adopts it (renaming an anonymous section to `section`), and destroying the resource only removes it from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `accept_redirects` (Boolean) Accept ICMP redirects. (UCI option `accept_redirects`.)
- `accept_source_route` (Boolean) Accept source-routed packets. (UCI option `accept_source_route`.)
- `auto_helper` (Boolean) Automatically assign conntrack helpers. (UCI option `auto_helper`.)
- `auto_includes` (Boolean) Load /etc/nftables.d includes (fw4). (UCI option `auto_includes`.)
- `custom_chains` (Boolean) Create custom user chains (fw3). (UCI option `custom_chains`.)
- `disable_ipv6` (Boolean) Disable IPv6 firewall rules. (UCI option `disable_ipv6`.)
- `drop_invalid` (Boolean) Drop invalid packets. (UCI option `drop_invalid`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `flow_offloading` (Boolean) Software flow offloading. (UCI option `flow_offloading`.)
- `flow_offloading_hw` (Boolean) Hardware flow offloading. (UCI option `flow_offloading_hw`.)
- `forward` (String) Default forward policy. (UCI option `forward`.) One of: `ACCEPT`, `REJECT`, `DROP`.
- `input` (String) Default input policy. (UCI option `input`.) One of: `ACCEPT`, `REJECT`, `DROP`.
- `output` (String) Default output policy. (UCI option `output`.) One of: `ACCEPT`, `REJECT`, `DROP`.
- `syn_flood` (Boolean) Enable SYN flood protection (legacy name). (UCI option `syn_flood`.)
- `synflood_protect` (Boolean) Enable SYN flood protection. (UCI option `synflood_protect`.)
- `tcp_ecn` (Number) TCP ECN: 0 off, 1 on, 2 when requested. (UCI option `tcp_ecn`.)
- `tcp_syncookies` (Boolean) Enable TCP SYN cookies. (UCI option `tcp_syncookies`.)
- `tcp_window_scaling` (Boolean) Enable TCP window scaling. (UCI option `tcp_window_scaling`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
